lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular pixel clusters are organized in approximately five discernible vertical columns immediately posterior to the fifth gill slit.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance spots to create a semi-regular grid of anchor nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal linear features run parallel to the body axis on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with highlights on the superior edge and shadows on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Strong caustic network patterns from surface light refraction are overlaid on the dorsal surface; multiple Echeneidae (remoras) are visible attached to the ventral and lateral surfaces.
